summary.text: Venton Jones is a Democratic member of the Texas House of Representatives for District 100 and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026.
He took office on January 10, 2023, succeeding Jasmine Crockett, and faces Republican Jordan Hoffnagle in the general election.

paragraphs.text: Venton Jones was born in Dallas, Texas.

He earned a bachelor's degree from Texas A&M University in 2006 and a graduate degree from the University of Texas at Arlington in 2009, and his career experience includes serving as CEO of a nonprofit organization.
Jones advanced from the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary into a runoff and defeated Amanda Richardson in the May 26, 2026 runoff.
In the 2023-2024 session, Ballotpedia lists him on the Corrections and Public Health committees.
